title: Ciclo e folgas: the cycle and days off shape the day

screens.title: 1 · Feed
screens.why: Today's cycle day and phase at a glance, and what it does to the day.

pins.label: Today
pins.text: Under the date: CycleTag (phase colour + icon: drop, plant, sun, moon) and DayMarkTag (Dia leve · 3h). Nothing without a cycle on a working day.

pins.label: Agent
pins.text: The suggestion and every turn read the day's kind and phase: on a light day it moves a delivery's task to the next working day.

screens.title: 2 · Menu
screens.why: Where the cycle and the days off are set: a new section, Ritmo.

pins.label: Ritmo
pins.text: Ciclo (today's phase icon, Dia 2 · Menstruação; without one, a line asking for it) and Folgas (couch). Each opens its page.

screens.title: 3 · Ciclo
screens.why: Where the cycle stands, the next 30 days by phase, and the one thing to do each month.

pins.label: Today
pins.text: In the phase's fill: Dia 2 de 28, Menstruação até 1 de nov., and what it does to the day.

pins.label: Next cycle
pins.text: The one primary button: Menstruação começou hoje. A new cycle starts today; every prediction moves.

pins.label: 30 days
pins.text: Sunday-first grid, each day in its phase's colours, today ringed; the four phases keyed under it.

pins.label: Settings
pins.text: Below: last period's start, cycle length (28), period length (5), and Na menstruação Normal / Leve / Folga (default Leve).

screens.title: 4 · Folgas
screens.why: Every day the queue keeps off or goes easy on, whatever set it.

pins.label: Weekend
pins.text: Saturday and Sunday each Normal / Leve / Folga, the control the cycle uses. Default Normal: nothing moves until set.

pins.label: Light day
pins.text: How much a light day takes (3h of loose tasks). Delivery tasks wait for a working day; deadlines count working days.

pins.label: Dates
pins.text: Dates off (couch) and the cycle's next period with its kind, in date order, then + Adicionar.

screens.title: 5 · Calendário
screens.why: The queue honours the kind of each day, and the heading says it.

pins.label: Heading
pins.text: The same DayMarkTag after the day's name, in Lista and Calendário: Dia leve · 3h (drop: the period), Folga (couch).

pins.label: Fixed stays
pins.text: A fixed block on a day off stays; no free stretches are drawn around it, and no task is queued there.

pins.label: Day off
pins.text: A day off with nothing on it is one quiet row (RestDayTile), not 15 hours of room. A tap still writes there.
